The Tier A thinking-quality gaps, each built around the failure that makes it

  anomalies you flagged, which finds known unknowns. This looks for structure
  instead. An anomaly an existing model explains is excluded; five anomalies
  from one instrument is a fact about the instrument, not a hidden mechanism;
  an expected-but-absent thing counts only if the expectation was declared with
  a time and a reason beforehand, since a retrofitted expectation explains
  anything. And a domain no source covers produces silence that reads exactly
  like absence, so it is reported as a limit of the search — "we looked and
  found nothing" and "we could not have seen it" are different sentences.

  Assumption Escape / Incompleteness Awareness — a question whose answer flips
  when an assumption is dropped was decided before the reasoning started, and
  more reasoning inside a closed set produces confidence rather than
  information. An alternative foundation predicting identically everywhere is
  one foundation described twice. When no available observation separates them
  the answer is UNDECIDABLE_WITHIN_AVAILABLE_EVIDENCE and no plausibility
  ranking is emitted, because ranking there is the assumption set voting on its
  own replacement.

  N-of-1 Personal Science — a personal history is not a dataset, and the reason
  has nothing to do with sample size: the subject changed. A series crossing a
  declared regime change is split rather than pooled. Length does not promote a
  design, so two hundred observations of a before-and-after is a long
  before-and-after. A design that named no confounders has not looked for any,
  and blocks the causal claim rather than caveating it.

  Anti-Fragility Map — three retainers from one client is one income source.
  Redundancy counts independent failure modes, never instances, so a domain
  whose instances share a mode is a single point of failure however many it
  has. A fragility class is earned by an observed stress; ROBUST written on an

  prediction is held beside the observation so it can be scored later.

  Freedom Gradient / Agency Geometry — effective freedom is a funnel of seven
  gates, not an option count. Coercion and non-endorsement disqualify outright

commits.message:
The body, the room, and the parts of experience that do not survive language

Every other module here treats reasoning as though it happens in a person
shaped like a decision procedure. It does not. Sleep, illness, light,
noise, the people in the room and how long since eating move cognition
more than most of what the rest of this system reasons about, and none of
it reaches a decision packet unless something puts it there. So the
physical state a decision was made in is recorded beside it -- not folded
in, and explicitly not grounds to invalidate the decision. The useful
question later is not "was this a good decision" but "was this made on
four hours of sleep", and that is unanswerable if nobody captured it.

The harder half is what cannot be represented at all. A system that
models everything will translate an experience into the nearest thing its
ontology holds, and the translation reads as the experience. So the
untranslatable layer marks that something was not captured and flags the
record as unsafe to reason over. Storing an approximation is worse than
losing the experience: the paraphrase becomes the data.

A measurement never settles what an experience was like -- the
characteristic mistake of quantified-self systems, and both the report
and the measurement are kept with neither overriding. A simulation
frequency is never a real-world probability; the moment it is read as one
the sandbox has become a forecast nobody validated. The soul archive is
excluded from every optimization input, so continuity of personhood does
not depend on the measurable parts of a life.

Two smaller ones that matter. Reasoning depth scales with what being
wrong costs, because exhaustive analysis of a trivial choice spends the
attention an irreversible one needed. And the information diet is
described but never curated: curating the inputs would be shaping him
through the salience channel this system elsewhere audits.

commits.author: Claude
commits.message:
Where a life compounds, and what a finite one costs

life-autopoiesis.mjs. The ordinary framing is balance -- domains
competing for a fixed pool of hours, a good life being a good allocation.
That framing loses the thing that actually compounds, which is not any
domain but the loops between them: health into energy into learning into
capability into opportunity into freedom into a better environment into
health. So the module returns the specific cycle rather than a score. A
number saying a life is 0.7 autopoietic is unactionable.

The second half is the constraint the first runs inside. Time is finite
and elapsed time does not come back, so a system that optimizes a life
can consume the life it was optimizing -- the failure a lifetime
optimizer is most likely to cause and least likely to notice, because
every individual deferral is defensible. mortalHorizon surfaces it as a
question and says plainly that no ratio decides how someone spends their
years.

Three refusals carry the rest. Time, youth and opportunity windows are
irreplaceable whatever the caller passes, because pricing them in the
same currency as money makes the trade look acceptable every time.
RECURRING is in the window vocabulary so "this comes round again" is
sayable -- treating a recurring opportunity as scarce spends a window
that was not closing. And preserveMystery can return LEAVE_THIS_ALONE: a
perfectly scheduled friendship is a worse friendship, and a sufficiently
capable system knows when to stop.

Serendipity reports field heterogeneity and refuses to predict the
discovery, since predicting it would be choosing it in advance. Twenty
contexts in one field is one context twenty times, and accidents happen
at edges. Explore/exploit is recorded per domain, never as one dial for a
life, which would be the scalar canon forbids.

Meaning archaeology surfaces three groups, and the interesting one is
usually missing: experiences that did not feel like much at the time and
grew. It has no view on what should have mattered.

commits.message:
Epistemics, memory sovereignty, and the path from a choice to a consequence

epistemic-immune-system.mjs. A reasoning system's most dangerous output
is not a wrong answer but a confident one whose confidence came from
somewhere other than evidence -- model agreement, a compression that
dropped the decisive exception, a correlation nobody tested against an
intervention. Each produces a claim shaped exactly like a good one, so
each failure mode gets a name here. Ignorance has a type and an unstated
state resolves to UNKNOWN rather than upward. Uncertainty has four
classes, because treating deep uncertainty as risk licenses optimization
over a state space nobody established. Causal claims carry a rung, and an
intervention claim from an observational rung is refused -- "doing X
causes Y" from correlation is the most consequential silent upgrade in
applied reasoning. Model ecology counts distinct methods, not models.

Above all of it, internalSupportOffsetsObservation is permanently false.
Three internal supports against one observation still means the model
revises, and the mutation that made it a weighing exercise is dead.

memory-sovereignty.mjs. "We have the data but we do not infer from it"
is a promise no store keeps by accident, so opacity is enforced where
inference happens rather than promised in a policy. Five layers, only two
of which may inform an inference; the do-not-infer mark survives
promotion between them, because otherwise any later process could move an
opaque record into the active model and the mark would evaporate. The
obvious route around it -- file it away, bring it back -- is refused
explicitly.

Forgetting keeps the record and drops its claim on the present: deleting
loses the history that makes a change of mind legible, keeping it active
lets a person's past keep voting. A standing request not to know is
honoured and research continues privately, because truth is not
automatically a gift. A prior captured after the recommendation is
refused as contaminated -- it is a reaction to the framing, not an
independent view. And UNDECIDED is the default posthumous disposition,
which the system never resolves: an accumulated life does not become
someone's dataset by default.

intent-compiler.mjs. Decisions die in chat windows, and the fix is a path
from will to consequence traceable both ways. Compilation stops where its
inputs run out and names the stage, because a plan that silently assumed
a permission is the failure. Reaching PERMISSIONS means an authority was
presented, not that the module may act -- businessEffectAuthority stays
NONE on a ready plan, and INTENT-02 holds that. The consequence ledger
keeps the unpredicted column, since a ledger holding only what was
intended is a record of hopes. Lock-in distinguishes a chosen commitment
from an accumulated constraint: both close futures, only one was decided.

One mutation survived and the fixture was at fault. EPIST-05 had equal
internal support and contradictions, where "weigh them up" and "reality
wins" agree. Three supports against one observation is the realistic
shape of that failure and the mutation now dies on it.

commits.message:
Two organs that guard the person against the system modelling them

living-self-model.mjs. Personalization fails in a characteristic
direction: it learns what someone did, recommends more of it, and the
model quietly replaces their ability to become someone else. Canon names
the mechanism -- identity compression, where "inexperienced at X" is
recorded as "bad at X". The two claims behave identically today and
produce opposite futures, and the cost of the wrong one is borne by a
person for years, so a durable claim now requires varied contexts. "He is
not a morning person" from a fortnight of bad sleep is refused.

Competing readings of an observation are preserved rather than resolved:
the system does not get to decide which explanation of a person is true.
Preference origin is shown and never judged -- marking socially-pressured
wants inauthentic would be the system deciding which of a person's
desires count, which is exactly the capture it exists to prevent. And a
first-order want is kept apart from a second-order endorsement, because a
system that cannot tell "I want this" from "I want to want this" will
optimize someone toward whatever they currently crave.

Unknown-self probes rank by what reality has never exposed rather than by
predicted enjoyment. Predicted enjoyment is the cage: it can only ever
return more of what the past already showed.

salience-sovereignty.mjs. A system can be scrupulously honest in every
individual claim and still decide the outcome by ordering, emphasis, or
by which option never reached the page -- and that failure is invisible
from inside, because the recommendation was true and the reasoning was
sound. So the shape of what was shown is recorded, and an omission with
no stated reason is logged as NONE_GIVEN rather than dropped: an unlogged
omission is indistinguishable from a decision nobody made.

Frame dependence needs both orderings and refuses to infer from one --
without the second the answer is unknown, not clean. The attention budget
defaults to silence on a tie, because a system resolving ties toward
speaking will speak constantly, and it counts the displaced mental state
as a cost, which is the cost that never appears on any ledger. Drift
reports convergence as a question: a high agreement rate is equally
consistent with the system being right and with the founder having
stopped disagreeing, and this does not pretend to tell them apart.

The salience ledger is wired into the control surface describing that
very response. A surface auditing every decision except its own
presentation would have the one blind spot that matters.

Three life organs, each refusing the operation that would make it useless

life-decision-dimensions.mjs. "No single metric defines a good life" is
easy to agree with and almost impossible to keep, because every
comparison wants a number and the moment dimensions become commensurable
something has set the exchange rate between meaning and money. That
exchange rate is the value judgment, and it is not the system's. So this
refuses the one operation everything downstream will ask for: it produces
no total, and the test asserts no total, score, winner or ranking field
exists anywhere on the result. What it reports instead is dominance --
the only comparison needing no exchange rate -- and tradeoffs left as
tradeoffs. Cost dimensions invert, or the whole comparison points
backwards on exactly the dimensions people care about.

reachable-futures.mjs. The failure here is not bad forecasting, it is a
simulated Mohamed acquiring a vote: generate enough futures, notice eight
of ten regret a choice, and the counting starts to feel like evidence --
but the eight came from one assumption set, so what was measured is the
generator. Futures therefore carry a mandatory lineage, and an ancestor
must cross independent lineages rather than repeat inside one. The
council surfaces disagreement and computes no majority; positions record
who holds them, never how many, because a tally is a vote. The telescope
refuses a projection whose uncertainty narrows with distance -- false
precision exactly where it is least checkable. Closing branches by
commitment is not scored as loss, or the module would recommend against
every commitment a life is made of.

human-capability-genome.mjs. The canon warning is specific: never
silently convert a temporary state or skill gap into a fixed trait. "Bad
at X" and "inexperienced at X under these conditions" behave identically
today and produce opposite futures, and the cost of being wrong is borne
by a person for years. So a DURABLE_LIMIT claim is refused unless varied
or longitudinal evidence supports it, a thin assessment stays
provisional, and the provisional flag is carried through Osteogenesis so
it cannot harden into a verdict on the way. Delegation and atrophy are
counted separately: delegating something still practised is not losing
it, and merging them either cries wolf or hides the real losses.

Two mutations survived and both were mine to fix. LIFEDIM-04 exposed a
real gap -- an out-of-range score was being coerced rather than dropped,
which records an assessment nobody made, on the pessimistic end.
LIFEDIM-02 was a redundant guard rather than an untested one: an empty
shared-dimension set already yields an empty wins set, and both branches
require a win. The guard is gone and the reasoning is in the comment
where the next reader will need it.

All three are wired into api/sovereign-control.mjs so they have callers.

commits.message:
OMEGA-05/11: experiences that resist scoring, and the firewall before value

Two organs the North Star names and nothing implemented.

experience-compiler.mjs. The obvious version of this module is a scoring
function over experiences, and the obvious version is the failure: a
system that ranks a life by expected value recommends against rest,
against play, against the unrepeatable thing that produces no measurable
gain, and is internally correct every time. So three things sit outside
the arithmetic rather than inside it as penalty terms -- a penalty term
can always be outweighed by a large enough number somewhere else.
An experience whose whole value is being had leaves the ranking entirely
rather than scoring zero. An age-, person- or moment-bound experience is
set apart rather than given a bonus. A declared off-limits domain stays
unmodelled however useful modelling it would be, and the usefulness is
recorded precisely so it can be seen not to have won.

Compound value counts dimensions rather than summing them, because a sum
erases the difference between a little of six things and a lot of one --
the difference the compiler exists to surface. The module ships no
weighting: a weight vector is a claim about what matters, and one shipped
in a module would be the imposed worldview the canon forbids.

ruin-firewall.mjs. Expected value gets ruin wrong in a specific way: it
averages over paths, and ruin is the path where there are no further
paths. A bet with excellent expected value and a 3% chance of ending the
game is not a good bet made 33 times. So this screens before any scoring
and no number clears an absorbing outcome -- a firewall rather than a
penalty, and with no probability threshold, because a threshold is a
number someone tunes downward under pressure and the tuning always
happens on the option somebody already wants. An unclassified outcome
blocks the screen rather than passing as safe: the unclassified one is
usually the novel one, which is exactly what has no label yet and exactly
what matters. A recovery plan without a detection step is refused,
because nothing starts the clock. correlatedExposure reports effective
independent positions, since five sharing one dependency are one.

Both are wired into api/sovereign-control.mjs, so they have a caller. The
ruin screen is reported alongside the decision packet and never folded
into the ranking -- an option that can end the ability to choose again is
not a low-scoring option, it is a different kind of thing, and the test
pins that the 97%-good bet still wins the ranking while failing the
screen.

One fixture defect found by running it: the compound-value test set the
broad experience to 0.2x4 = 0.8 against 1.0, but originally 0.3x4 = 1.2,
where summing and counting agree -- so it passed under either rule and
proved nothing. The magnitudes now disagree by construction.

OMEGA-02/03/04/12/13: the decision organs, and a caller so they are not dead

Five lanes, one spine. The economic and software organs already existed;
what was missing was everything between an observation and an act.

sovereignty-type-system.mjs (OMEGA-04) is the spine. UberBond's
constitutional failure mode is not a wrong answer, it is a silent
promotion: an observation becomes a belief, a belief a prediction, a
prediction arrives worded as a command, and the command runs because it
sounded confident. Every step reads fine in a log. Three edges on the
ladder are human acts rather than inferences -- is->ought,
recommendation->choice, choice->authority -- and rung-skipping is refused
too, because without that an observation promoted straight to a
recommendation never touches PREDICTION->VALUE at all. The highest source
rung governs a derivation, so one value judgment cannot hide inside nine
facts. Delegation must originate with the founder, name the action and
expire; re-delegation may only attenuate and may not outlive its parent
-- the failure that is actually hard to see is a chain where every hop
narrows the action set while the expiry walks forward.

sovereign-decision-packet.mjs (OMEGA-02) sits between two failures that
look identical from outside because both end in a confident answer:
a universe that was five wordings of one option, and a probability with
nothing under it. Options merge on a causal signature, so the merge count
exposes a generator producing variants. A probability requires
quantitative evidence -- a causal model says how, not how often -- and
correlated sources count once, because ten models sharing a corpus are
one observation repeated. The packet stops at RECOMMENDATION and declines
to name a winner when the remaining difference is a value choice.

meta-rational-boundary.mjs (OMEGA-03) supplies the five terminal states,
four of which are refusals. The irreducible check runs before evidence,
so abundant data cannot quietly convert a value question into a
statistical one. shouldContinueReasoning is the state most often missing
from systems like this, and its absence is why they consume the life they
were built to improve.

reality-calibration-ledger.mjs (OMEGA-13) makes forecasting falsifiable.
Forecasts are sealed over claim, probabilities and cutoff, so a
post-outcome edit cannot be scored; an outcome predating the cutoff
measures memory rather than prediction; an outcome outside the state
space is recorded as the stronger finding rather than discarded. Decision
quality is judged on what was knowable, so a lucky bad decision does not
become doctrine and an unlucky good one is not mislearned.

api/sovereign-control.mjs (OMEGA-12) exists because without a caller the
four modules above are exactly what the reachability ratchet was built to
catch: implemented, tested, green and dead. GET-only, admin-token gated,
and it does not import the private core -- every entry point here runs
without a person present, so a route that could read private life state
would hand it to whatever holds the token. It reads the constitution from
the modules that enforce it rather than restating it, so the surface
cannot claim a property the code has stopped holding.

Two defects found by running the gates rather than by reading:

  - CALIB-05 survived its first anchoring. The fixture landed on Brier
    exactly 0.5, where outcome-based and knowability-based scoring agree,
    so the mutation was unobservable. Added the two cases the guard
    exists for -- the lucky bad decision and the unlucky good one.
  - The control surface reported "Stay" as irreversible. The universe
    normalized *unstated* reversibility to false and the glue read that
    as *declared irreversible*. Doing nothing is not a commitment.
    Reversibility is now three states; the signature still folds unstated
    in with not-reversible, which is the conservative grouping.

OMEGA-01: the private core, and repair four silent validator regressions

Personal Civilization private core (src/personal-civilization-core.mjs).
Two invariants carry it, both chosen because their absence is invisible
until it is catastrophic:

  1. Private life data can never reach a repository path. The repo is
     public; a leak here is permanent, in a public git history, about a
     person. The check is on the destination, not the intent, because
     intent is what fails silently.
  2. Deleting a life event deletes everything derived from it. A Living
     Model that survives its sources is a copy of the deleted data under
     another name.

Founder authority is an authorization object carried on the call, not a
boolean on the record, so an autonomous lane cannot reach private state
by constructing a plausible request. 23 focused tests; PCIV-01..05 all
KILLED.

PCIV-03 survived its first anchoring: the transitive test listed sources
before their derivations, so a single pass propagated the whole chain and
could not tell a fixpoint from one iteration. Added an order-independent
case; the mutation now dies.

Classified DELIBERATELY_UNREACHABLE -- a new category, because the
existing ones only say "not wired yet" and filing it under
AWAITING_ACTIVATION would invite a future session to finish the job by
wiring it. Every entry point here runs without a person present, so
reaching this module is itself the harm. Added the reverse ratchet: a
deliberately unreachable module becoming reachable fails, rather than
being quietly dropped from the classification as reachable modules are.

Coverage matrix gains a verified declaration layer. The matcher finds
evidence by filename, which left every concept whose name never became a
filename reading SPEC_ONLY forever -- personal-civilization-core.mjs
implements the Thought Ocean without the phrase in its path. A
declaration supplies files only; classifyState still decides, so a
declaration with no test cannot reach VERIFIED_CURRENT, cannot name a
file that is not in the tree, and cannot name a concept the canon does
not contain. One bad entry fails the whole compile. 34 -> 39
VERIFIED_CURRENT, 917 -> 912 SPEC_ONLY.

Four regressions found by running the suite rather than by looking:
16 failures, 14 of which predated this work.

  - docs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.json had been rewritten into a new schema
    carrying none of the four fields the brain loader requires, taking
    `npm run brain` offline. Core fields restored alongside the 2.2.0
    keys rather than reverting them.
  - The same rewrite dropped cloudActivationTruth and
    repositoryPublicationEffects. Restored byte-for-byte from 73cb932e:
    they are observations with provenance and re-deriving them from
    memory would have invented evidence.
  - requiresMemoryV2: three places tested `schemaVersion === '1.1.0'`,
    so the 1.2.0 bump switched off memory-index validation, the required
    memory paths and the chat-import instruction -- silently, on main,
    with every suite green. A requirement introduced by a schema belongs
    to every schema after it. BRAIN-SCHEMA-01/02 hold it.
  - One bootstrap goal was 518 chars against a 500 cap, so the whole
    goals array was rejected. Split into the rule and its roster; every
    named initiative survives.

check:syntax 999 files. Deterministic 4021 tests, 3966 pass, 1 fail
(canon freshness, which can only go green in the regeneration commit
that follows this one), 54 skipped.

commits.message:
OMEGA-00: compile the no-drop coverage matrix from 1068 canonical concepts

The exact denominator, computed rather than asserted: 1068 concepts extracted
from ten canonical sources, 1038 rows, 30 alias merges, zero dropped.

UberBond's recurring failure has never been losing code. It has been losing
concepts -- an idea named once, donated by a superseded program, or buried in a
list of 170, quietly falling out of the project's own account of itself. So the
compiler refuses to emit a matrix whose row count does not equal its input
count, and every row's state is computed from repository evidence.

Getting the evidence honest took three corrections, each in a different
direction:

- **It indexed only src/.** Mutation War is a scripts/ module with seven suites
  and a mutation registry behind it, and it was reporting SPEC_ONLY -- an idea
  nobody had built. scripts/ and api/ are implementation surfaces and are now
  indexed.
- **Compound names matched nothing.** Canon names a concept and its qualifier in
  one string ("Mutation War and independent verification"), and requiring every
  word found nothing. Names now split on explicit conjunctions.
- **That split is also how this becomes a fiction.** "GENESIS for Life" contains
  "GENESIS", and scoring it off that would invent a Personal Civilization organ
  out of an unrelated frontier engine. So names are never split on whitespace,
  and a part-match is recorded as SUB_PHRASE and capped at PARTIAL_CURRENT --
  part of a concept existing is a different fact from the concept existing.

Verified in both directions: Mutation War, Capability Genome and Wallbreaker
find their evidence; every "for Life" variant correctly stays SPEC_ONLY.

The matcher's conservative bias is recorded in the artifact itself, because
SPEC_ONLY must not be read as a finding. "Event Horizon capital allocation"
reads SPEC_ONLY while src/event-horizon.mjs exists. An under-claimed row is a
lead for a human; an over-claimed one is a lie that compounds.

OMEGA-MATRIX-01 had to be re-anchored. The drop-detection check is a backstop no
current input can reach, so mutating it survived every test -- unfalsifiable
rather than untested. It stays, with a note saying why it carries no mutation,
and the mutation moved to the merge branch that actually decides whether a
second naming is remembered.
